source:
@@U00678@@
Who do you think they are, those strangers?

@@U00680@@
Leave it to me. A good tall drink and I’ll have
wormed out of them their darkest secret.
My guess is they're nobles,
what with their haughty discontent.

@@U00682@@
I think they're quacks.

@@U00684@@
Could be.

@@U00686@@
Watch me. I'll get it out of them.

@@U00688@@
(To 浮士德.)

@@U00689@@
These simpletons wouldn't recognize the Devil
if he had them by the throat.

@@U00691@@
Good evening, gentlemen!

@@U00693@@
And the same to you, sirs!

@@U00694@@
(In an undertone, eyeing 梅菲斯特 askance.)

@@U00695@@
Look at that, would you?
He limps with one foot.

@@U00697@@
May we join you?
In place of a decent drink,
which of course can’t be had here,
we'll at least enjoy your company.

@@U00699@@
My, aren't we particular!
translation:
@@U00678@@
你认为那些陌生人是谁？

@@U00680@@
交给我吧。我要喝一杯好酒
从他们身上探出了最黑暗的秘密。
我猜他们都是贵族
他们傲慢的不满又如何呢？

@@U00682@@
我认为他们是庸医。

@@U00684@@
可能是。

@@U00686@@
看着我。我会从他们那里得到它。

@@U00688@@
（致浮士德。）

@@U00689@@
这些傻瓜不会认出魔鬼
如果他掐住了他们的喉咙。

@@U00691@@
晚上好，先生们！

@@U00693@@
先生们，您也一样！

@@U00694@@
（低声斜视梅菲斯特。）

@@U00695@@
看看那个，你愿意吗？
他一只脚跛行。

@@U00697@@
我们可以加入你吗？
代替像样的饮料，
这当然不能在这里得到，
我们至少会喜欢有你的陪伴。

@@U00699@@
我的天，我们是不是很特别啊！
